run_imagenet_resized: run the imagenet_resized script to generate fake ImageNet8 train and validation npz archives
test_generate_data: test the _generate_data function that creates fake ImageNet8 training and validation data archives
test_write_zipped: test the _write_zipped function that saves numpy arrays as npz and wraps them in a zip file
run_main_cli: run the main CLI entry point with an optional --tfds_dir flag to specify the output directory
test_flags_tfds_dir: test the --tfds_dir flag that defaults to utils.tfds_write_path() for the tensorflow_datasets directory
